paper_title: A Telescope Search for Decaying Relic Axions
coupling_convention: xi (dimensionless two-photon coupling parameter, xi = (4/3)(E/N - 1.92)); NOT g_agamma in GeV^-1
notes: Telescope search for optical line emission from two-photon decay of relic thermal axions in galaxy clusters Abell 2667 and 2390 using VLT VIMOS IFU. Paper reports 95% CL upper limits on the dimensionless two-photon coupling parameter xi (Table I), NOT g_agamma in GeV^-1. Conversion to g_agamma requires the axion lifetime relation tau = 6.8e24 xi^-2 m_a,eV^-5 s and is mass-dependent; raw xi values emitted here. Valid mass window 4.5-7.7 eV. Not a haloscope, so no local DM density assumed (thermal relic abundance Omega_a h^2 = m_a,eV/130 assumed).
